question: Which famous male lawn tennis player retired in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roger Federer is the latest star to retire from the sport.**
 
• The **Swiss maestro** announced his decision to call time on his career a few weeks ago, and the** 2022 Laver Cup** was the scene where he played the final match of his career.
 
• **Roger Federer** is a professional tennis player from **Switzerland**, widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time.
 
• He has won a record** 20 Grand Slam singles titles**, including **eight Wimbledon titles**, and has spent over **300 weeks** as the **world No. 1 ranked player.**
 
• Federer has also won a gold medal in doubles at the **2008 Beijing Olympics** and a silver medal in singles at the **2012 London Olympics.**
 
• He is known for his **elegant playing style, exceptional shot-making ability, and sportsmanship on and off the court.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn3.gstatic.com/licensed-image?q=tbn:ANd9GcTSzsa68GeFo6OZUyJlXvNGMEdxTSaFfphyzJeD5zcTcU25s66kYVQfpSGsqMzJ4gNWxiXhayaWZgX8n3M] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Rafael Nadal is a professional tennis player from Spain and is widely regarded as one of the greatest tennis players of all time.**

 
 
• He has won** 20 Grand Slam** singles titles, tied with Roger Federer for the most in men's tennis history, and has won the French Open a record 13 times.
 
• Nadal has also won** two Olympic gold medals, **one in singles at the **2008 Beijing Olympics** and the other in doubles at the **2016 Rio Olympics**. Known for his tenacious play, Nadal is considered one of the best clay court players of all time and has had success on all surfaces.
 
• Off the court, he is known for his philanthropic work, particularly with his foundation which focuses on education and social integration for disadvantaged youth.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.britannica.com/33/226733-050-1F65CDDD/Rafael-Nadal-championship-trophy-US-Open-USTA-Billie-Jean-King-National-Tennis-Center-September-8-2019.jpg] 

 
• **Novak Djokovic is a professional tennis player from Serbia and is currently ranked as the world No. 1 in men's singles tennis by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP).**

 
 
• He has won** 20 Grand Slam singles titles,** tied with Rafael Nadal and Roger Federer for the most in men's tennis history. Djokovic has won all four Grand Slam tournaments at least twice, including nine Australian Open titles, five Wimbledon titles, three US Open titles, and two French Open titles.
 
• He is also a** five-time ATP Finals champion** and has won a total of **84 career ATP singles titles.**
 
• Djokovic is known for his exceptional flexibility, court coverage, and return of serve.
 
• He is considered one of the best returners in the history of the game and has a strong all-court game that allows him to succeed on all surfaces.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.britannica.com/36/223036-050-9CF5317C/Novak-Djokovic-trophy-US-Open-singles-match-2018.jpg] 

 
• **Carlos Alcaraz is a young professional tennis player from Spain**.

 
 
• He was born on May 5, 2003, and has quickly established himself as one of the most promising talents in the sport.
 
• Alcaraz turned professional in 2018 and has since won two ATP Challenger titles, as well as his first ATP Tour title at the age of 18 in Umag, Croatia, in July 2021.
 
• He is known for his aggressive playing style and powerful groundstrokes, particularly his forehand. Alcaraz has been compared to his fellow Spaniard Rafael Nadal, and many tennis experts consider him to be one of the future stars of the sport.
